info.title: Content API
info.description:
APIs for uploading, retrieving, and deleting hosted content files. Supports
binary file upload and provides a hosted URL for use in messaging payloads,
along with operations to retrieve or remove previously uploaded files by
their file ID.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to
The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

requestBody.description: The details and data for the file

id.description: The file's unique identifier - used to GET

url.description: A unique url that can be used to retrieve the content

name.description: The file name of the content

folder.description: The folder in which the content was stored

size.description: The size in bytes of the content uploaded

_createdOn.description: The date (in UTC, ISO 8601 format) that the content was created

_createdBy.description: The identity that created the content

_updatedOn.description: The date (in UTC, ISO 8601 format) that the content was last updated

_updatedBy.description: The identity that created the content
